title: ntfyzero
summary: Unofficial ntfy client: push notifications with per-topic alerts
description: ntfyzero is an unofficial, keyboard-driven client for ntfy, on ntfy.sh or your own server. Subscribe to topics on several servers, then read messages with their priority, tags, links (shown as text and a QR code) and image attachments, run HTTP actions, and publish messages. Alerts play a tone, show a banner and can repeat until you press a key, with global and per-topic settings for sound, volume, minimum priority, mute and quiet hours. Messages and alerts arrive while the app is open; when you open it again, it catches up from the server's message cache.
